overview.overview:
Virginia is expected to lean Democratic in 2028, running noticeably ahead of the national baseline in this forecast. The state backed the Democratic presidential nominee by 10.1 points in 2020 and by 5.8 points in 2024, a narrowing that still left it a clear Democratic result.

With 13 electoral votes, Virginia is unlikely to decide the election on its own. No public polling of the state is currently available, so the outlook rests on recent results, the broader national environment, and the 2026 midterm Senate race, which was decided by a 22.7-point margin.
overview.watch: A sharp national shift toward Republicans, or a Republican nominee with strong appeal in Northern Virginia's suburbs, could narrow the margin considerably.
key_factors: Democrats won Virginia by 10.1 points in 2020 and by 5.8 points in 2024.
The state runs well ahead of the national baseline in this forecast.
No public polls or home-state candidates are currently available to adjust the outlook.
